official.deadline_note: The Pearson cycle runs on chained deadlines well ahead of normal admission: school nomination October 9, 2026, U of T admission application through OUAC October 16, 2026, and the Pearson scholarship application plus all documentation November 6, 2026. The general 2027 admission deadline of January 15, 2027 does not extend the Pearson cycle.
official.status_note: The 2027-entry cycle is live on the official page: nomination forms were distributed to previously participating schools from July 6, 2026, the nomination deadline was October 9, 2026, and nominated students have until November 6, 2026 to complete the scholarship application. Recipients are notified starting at the end of January, and all nominees are notified of decisions by April.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official page states the Pearson International Student Scholarships cover tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years, and that the scholarship is tenable only at the University of Toronto for first-entry, undergraduate programs.
benefits: Cover tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years
Tenable only at the University of Toronto for first-entry, undergraduate programs
Approximately 37 students named Pearson Scholars each year
Access to the Pearson Program Office enrichment and support programming for current scholars
eligibility: An international student (i.e. a non-Canadian requiring a study permit)
Enrolled in your final year of senior secondary school in 2026/2027, or have graduated no earlier than June 2026
Beginning your studies at the University of Toronto in September 2027
Nominated by your secondary school, which can nominate only one student per year
Students already attending post-secondary studies, or starting post-secondary studies in January 2027, are not eligible
requirements: Nominated by your current secondary school through the online nomination process
Apply for admission to at least one undergraduate program at the University of Toronto through the OUAC
Complete the Pearson Scholarship application sent via a private link after nomination
Submit all required documentation by the scholarship application deadline
Do not use generative AI tools to create any content in the application
Meet the University of Toronto undergraduate English language requirement
documents: Completed Pearson International Scholarship application via the private link received after school nomination
OUAC application for admission to at least one University of Toronto undergraduate program
All required documentation submitted with the scholarship application by November 6, 2026
selection_criteria: Leadership potential, recognized as leaders within their school
Potential to contribute positively to the global community
application_method: Ask your guidance counsellor, principal or head of school whether your school is verified to nominate students
School submits the nomination form by October 9, 2026 (schools not yet verified must apply to participate by noon EST October 9, 2026)
Submit an OUAC application for undergraduate admission to at least one U of T program by October 16, 2026
Use the private Pearson Scholarship application link received after nomination
Submit the scholarship application and all documentation by November 6, 2026
official.application_route: School nomination first, then a U of T admission application through OUAC, then the private-link Pearson scholarship application.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students, defined by U of T as non-Canadians who require a study permit, including international students studying at Canadian high schools
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the award is exclusively for international students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to all first-entry undergraduate programs; if awarded, the scholarship is restricted to your top choice of program at the time scholarship decisions are made. U of T states the programme does not work with agencies or educational agents.
official.description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious award for international students, recognizing outstanding academic achievement, creativity and leadership potential. It is one of the largest scholarship programs for international students in Canada and covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years of first-entry undergraduate study.
official.program_type: University admission award for international undergraduate students
official.english_requirement: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0; TOEFL iBT (tests taken on or after January 21, 2026) overall 4.5 with 4.5 in Writing and 4.0 in Speaking, or 89 with 22 in Speaking and Writing on the previous scale; Duolingo English Test 120 overall with 120 in Production; PTE Academic 65 with no part below 60; CAEL 70 with no part below 60. Exemption possible after four or more years of full-time study at a recognized Canadian school or an English-language school in an English-dominant country. All applicants must also present a senior-level English course (equivalent to Ontario ENG4U). Scores must be sent directly to U of T by the testing agency.

verification.notes: U of T's official Pearson pages publish coverage in kind (tuition, books, incidental fees, full residence support) but no per-student dollar value; the only dollar figure published is programme-wide ('$12M+ funding in 2024'), which is not an award amount, so the funding fields are null. The FAQ block on the official Pearson page still shows the previous cycle's nomination dates (July 1, 2025 / October 10, 2025); the current 2027-entry dates in the page body (July 6, 2026 / October 9, 2026 / October 16, 2026 / November 6, 2026) were used. English requirements taken from the official U of T English language requirements page; enquiry route is the Pearson Scholarship Inquiry Form and pearson.scholarship@utoronto.ca.

applicant_utility.summary: This award is nomination-gated, so the decisive competition happens inside your own school long before U of T reviews anyone: each school can put forward only one candidate, and unverified schools must apply to join the programme by noon EST on October 9, 2026. The whole pipeline closes inside a nine-week window, making the October 16 OUAC deadline the practical make-or-break date because the scholarship application itself can only be completed after admission is submitted. Practically, you are not just applying to U of T - you are convincing your school that you are its single strongest candidate while simultaneously becoming admissible on your own merits. Plan for a long quiet stretch after submission, since decisions begin only in late January and every nominee hears by April.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Final-year secondary students at a school willing to nominate them, with top grades plus visible leadership, aiming to start a first-entry U of T undergraduate program in September 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: In early July, confirm with your counsellor whether your school already receives nomination forms or must apply to participate by noon EST October 9, 2026
Submit your OUAC application for at least one U of T undergraduate program by October 16, 2026 - no admission application means no scholarship application, whatever your nomination status
Order your program choices deliberately: if awarded, the scholarship attaches to your top choice at the moment decisions are made
Book an accepted English test early and have the testing agency send results directly to U of T, using the exact name and date of birth from your application
Write all application content yourself - generative AI use in any U of T undergraduate award application is grounds for disqualification
Have every supporting document ready to upload before the November 6, 2026 deadline, not on it
common_rejection_risks: Your school nominates a different student - one candidate per school per year eliminates most applicants before U of T ever sees them
Missing the October 16 OUAC deadline: nomination alone cannot proceed to a scholarship application without the admission application
Winning but losing the program fit - the award is tied to your top-choice program when decisions are made, so a later preference for a different program does not carry the scholarship
Generative AI detected in the application content, which U of T treats as automatic disqualification
Attending an unverified school that misses the noon EST October 9, 2026 participation deadline, leaving no nomination route at all
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Published coverage is limited to tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support; U of T's own fees guidance tells international students to also budget for University Health Insurance Plan (UHIP) costs, and travel to Canada and personal expenses are outside the published coverage.
document_audit: English test scores must be transmitted by the testing agency - applicant- or school-submitted scores are rejected, and the name and date of birth on the test registration must match the application

If claiming an English exemption (four or more years of study in Canada or an English-language school in an English-dominant country), request it via the Join U of T portal after receiving your acknowledgement email
The scholarship application exists only behind the private link sent after nomination and can only be completed after the OUAC submission, so there is no public form to practise on
Ignore the stale 2025-cycle dates in the official page's FAQ block and follow the 2026-cycle dates in the page body
alerts: The school nomination deadline (October 9, 2026) comes before any student deadline, so start the conversation with your counsellor in the summer, not the autumn
The Pearson cycle closes months before the standard January 15, 2027 admission deadline; applicants who wait for the normal deadline miss the scholarship entirely
U of T warns of fraudulent emails from agents offering application help for fees - the programme only works through your school and UofT's own portals
Students already in post-secondary study, or starting post-secondary study in January 2027, are explicitly ineligible
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: School submits the nomination (by October 9, 2026) -> student submits the OUAC admission application (by October 16, 2026) -> student completes the private-link scholarship application and uploads documentation (by November 6, 2026) -> decisions from late January, all nominees notified by April.
